propositions: Bug tickets lack metadata about their detection channel (canary, CI, review bot, human audit, user report), preventing escape-channel trend analysis.
An environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY (or optional CLI flag --detected-by) must be read at the create_core seam to stamp detected_by on all tickets created via CLI, library, or MCP ingress.
The detected_by field must normalize via strip+lowercase, treat empty/whitespace as unset, and accept unknown tokens verbatim without enum validation or creation failure.
The CREATE reducer must project detected_by into compiled state present-only (mirroring source_* blocks), and tickets without detected_by must reduce byte-identically to pre-change state.
Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypasses the composer seam and does not stamp detected_by to avoid mis-attributing human-authored tickets to the reconciler process.
